help_main:
- `/main` back to the main chat
- `/new` start a new chat (from your next message)
- `/list` recent chats, tap one to switch
help_agents:
- `/agents` the agents on your computers, tap one to chat with it here
- `/start` start a new agent on a computer
help_tasks: - `/tasks` everything in flight: what needs your call and the active tasks
help_workbench: - `/home` the workbench: one pinned card of everything going on, with a button for each place · `/today` the day at a glance · `/inbox` the Inbox (AI drafts, reply as you)
tasks_no_decide: Nothing is waiting on your decision.
help_always:
- `/stop` stop the current turn
- `/status` where messages go now
- `/help` this help
